note: How fillers on each venue wait for a deposit on Ethereum today. 'fill': a filler pays out on another chain before the Ethereum deposit is final. 'single-chain': orders settle on one chain. 'settlement': a clearing layer, not a fill venue. Waits come from each venue's reference code or docs; none reads Ethereum's safe block.

venues.name: Across
venues.win: The first relayer to fill wins the order.
venues.repaid: Repaid from HubPool bundles after a 30 minute challenge period; inventory moves over the canonical bridges.

venues.name: deBridge
venues.win: The first taker to fulfill the order wins it.
venues.repaid: Unlocked on Ethereum after deBridge validators confirm the fill, typically within a few hours.

venues.name: 1inch Fusion+
venues.win: Whitelisted resolvers bid in a Dutch auction.
venues.repaid: Withdrawn from the Ethereum escrow once the finality lock and the secret are out.
venues.source: Finality lock on all 99 Ethereum escrows created 21–22 Oct 2026

venues.name: Relay
venues.win: Solvers fill right away, with no auction window.
venues.repaid: Relay’s oracle credits an Ethereum deposit after 10 blocks and 60 seconds.
venues.source: Relay oracle config (solver waits are not published)

venues.name: Mayan
venues.win: Drivers bid in an auction on Solana; the best offer wins.
venues.repaid: Unlocked after Wormhole attests the Ethereum deposit.
venues.source: Mayan docs (driver waits are not published)

venues.name: Everclear
venues.repaid: Settles in batches over its own Hyperlane deployment; how long it waits on Ethereum is not published.
venues.source: Everclear contracts (its own Hyperlane mailbox on Ethereum, read on-chain 3 Nov 2026)

venues.name: UniswapX
venues.source: UniswapX README: every reactor settles on one chain
